Customers order their convenience, grocery, retail, and prepared foods in the DoorDash app, and our team members fulfill orders in a real, brick-and-mortar store for Dashers to deliver. We’re open early and close late - some sites even run 24/7! About the Role DashMart is looking for a motivated and experienced individual that excels in fast-paced, physical environments and is excited to roll up their sleeves and actively engage in day-to-day operations. In this role, you will work within a local fulfillment center supporting Site Management running great shifts, and delegating tasks. As a Shift Lead, you will have shift responsibility for fulfilling orders in a warehouse environment and maintaining inventory, and in some locations, this involves preparing food in a light-prep kitchen. Your contributions will help shape the future of our organization as we continue to push the boundaries of what's possible. As a Solutions Architect, Total Rewards you will interact directly with senior leaders and cross-functional partners across DoorDash to capture requirements while designing lasting solutions with Business Technology. This role will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing, and maintaining the compensation architecture and tooling used to evaluate and reward employees during our mid-year and annual cycles, including complex Workday configuration and downstream integrations. This role will report to the Sr. Manager of Business Technology Architecture. jobs.title: SPRINT Specialist
jobs.description_text: About the Team The SPRINT Support Operations team provides quality, high-touch, and experimental support to Customers, Merchants, and Dashers on the DoorDash platform. The ongoing objective of this team is to elevate the Customer support experience through pilots, experiments, and enhancements to daily activities. The team will operationalize and execute support experience experiments to achieve this objective. Successful experiments may be scaled and transitioned to the broader Support Ops organization. About the Role As a SPRINT Specialist, your role will be to leverage your Customer Support experience and flexibility to support our evolving business changes. Specialists will engage in new experiments and pilot initiatives for Customers, Merchants, and Dashers. Ongoing training along with project-specific content will be provided for each project to ensure success in light of the constantly changing nature of the experiments. The varying lengths of the experiments will determine training frequency; for example, training may occur monthly or even weekly. Additionally, the SPRINT team may assist with volume from other Support Operations lines of business depending on business needs (i.e. assisting temporarily with a T3 Cx backlog). Specialists will report to SPRINT Supervisors under the Global Support and Integrity Operations (GSIO) team. jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description_text: About the Team The Outside Account Management team at DoorDash partners with restaurant merchants to help them grow simply and profitable on the platform. Our mission is to support merchants throughout their journey – ensuring a positive experience while also helping them unlock meaningful growth opportunities. We work closely with merchants to understand their goals, solve operational challenges, and recommend growth strategies that fit their business – balancing thoughtful partnership with commercial impact. About the Role As a Strategic Partner Manager II (SPM) , you will own and grow relationships with a portfolio of SMB restaurant partners, operating with a high degree of autonomy and strategic judgment. You’ll lead complex, high-impact partnerships focused on driving long-term growth, profitability, and retention for merchants on the DoorDash platform. In this role, you’ll move beyond day-to-day account management to guide more strategic merchant conversations—helping partners think holistically about growth, operations, and how to scale their business with DoorDash. You’ll proactively adapt account plans as opportunities and challenges emerge, identify and address risks early, and consistently drive measurable outcomes across your book of business. jobs.title: Supervisor, Community Defense
jobs.description_text: About the team The Community Defense team works to continuously improve the quality of DoorDash operations through oversight of the background check process, adjudication, support handling, and various screening-related functions. As such, our team’s work balances protecting the safety of the platform with providing flexible earning opportunities in the communities that we serve. You will join a team of flexible, passionate individuals that are invested in building scalable and sustainable foundations upon which to continue to iterate towards the best future state. About the role As a Supervisor on our Community Defense Team, you will oversee a team of team leads, specialists, and frontline representatives responsible for providing the highest quality care to our Dashers at the forefront of our business. You’ll be responsible for managing the day to day operations of a growing company while maintaining and improving quality and efficiency metrics for your team. You will identify areas of opportunity while developing solutions that allow the team, Trust and Safety organization, and our partners to accelerate towards our goal of operational excellence. Your experience in people management, leadership, process improvement, collaboration, and cross-functional work will allow you to elevate the team to the next level. jobs.title: Supervisor, Community Response
jobs.description_text: About the team… DoorDash’s Trust and Safety team is seeking an experienced people leader to oversee a team of Trust and Safety frontline agents. The Trust and Safety Operations team is responsible for responding to safety incidents on the platform quickly, effectively and empathetically to ensure our consumers, dashers and merchants have a high quality and safe experience. The team is responsible for a variety of safety concerns for our community, including but not limited to: personal safety, threats, property damage, food safety, discrimination and personality disputes. Trust and Safety success relies on our team being able to identify harmful situations, communicate empathetically with survivors and make quick decisions to mitigate future risk. The goal is to provide the best support possible for those who have experienced an incident on the DoorDash platform and restore their status quo. As a people leader, you will be responsible for fostering team collaboration, employee development, and problem-solving. The ability to be physically present in our corporate Tempe office is deemed essential as you will be responsible for facilitating in-person 1:1 meetings with your direct reports, connecting with cross-functional partners, immediate problem-solving, and nurturing a collaborative team environment. jobs.description_text: About the Team DoorDash's Risk & Insurance team protects and strengthens our business by developing innovative insurance programs and operational strategies that support millions of deliveries worldwide. We partner across Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Data Science, and Operations to manage risk, improve customer outcomes, and enable the continued growth of one of the world's largest local commerce platforms. As DoorDash continues to scale globally, Insurance Claims Operations is evolving through artificial intelligence, automation, and digital transformation. Our organization is reimagining how claims are managed by leveraging technology to automate routine work, enhance operational decision-making, and create scalable solutions that improve efficiency while maintaining exceptional customer experiences. About the Role DoorDash is seeking an experienced Insurance Claims Supervisor to help lead the next generation of claims operations at the frontline. This role is responsible for leading a team of Claims Specialists, driving consistent, high-quality claims handling, coaching and developing talent, and helping bring AI-enabled workflows and automation into day-to-day operations. Working closely with cross-functional partners across Legal, Global Support, Community Support, Merchant Support, Engineering, Product, and Data Science, you'll help translate process improvements and emerging automation into day-to-day team performance. jobs.title: UAS Operations Specialist, Labs
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a UAS Operations Specialist -Maintenance , you’ll support commercial drone delivery under Part 107 & 135 through scheduled and unscheduled fleet maintenance, inspection, and troubleshooting, while working alongside Flight Operations. All hires complete internal maintenance qualification, aircraft rating checks, and applicable pilot training to maintain operational readiness and safety. Based on technical expertise, aviation background, and fleet requirements, specialists can also be appointed as Maintenance Technicians . These roles require formal company authorization along with FAA approval when mandated . You’ll also perform aircraft rigging, component replacements, routine bench testing, and support Part 107 maintenance test flights and system validation alongside Flight Test and Engineering teams within FAA operating limitations and safety controls. What You’ll Do Perform scheduled and unscheduled aircraft maintenance, preventative maintenance, inspections, and repairs across the commercial UAS fleet according to manufacturer procedures and Part 135 specs. Diagnose and troubleshoot avionic, electrical, mechanical, and software system faults , telemetry logs, and maintenance software. Maintain detailed aircraft logs, component history records, airworthiness tracking, and maintenance documentation in compliance with company SOPs and FAA regulations. jobs.title: UAS Operations Specialist - Pilot
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a UAS Operations Specialist , you’ll join Flight Operations as a pilot supporting commercial drone delivery under Part 135 . All hires complete the company’s FAA approved training, aircraft qualification, and checking requirements before serving as Remote Pilot in Command (RPIC) and maintain required recurrent training, currency, and proficiency. Qualified pilots may be selected as a Flight Instructor, Ground Instructor, or Check Pilot based on experience, demonstrated proficiency, and program needs. These assignments require additional qualification, evaluation, company designation, and FAA approval where required . You’ll also support Part 107 flight testing, developmental operations, and system validation as assigned, working alongside Flight Test and cross-functional teams within applicable FAA authorizations, operating limitations, and established safety controls. What You’ll Do Serve as a commercial UAS RPIC , once qualified and authorized, under the direction of the Flight Operations Lead, Assistant Chief Pilot, and Chief Pilot. Complete required initial ground and flight training, aircraft-specific qualification, and knowledge and competency checks , including supervised operating experience where required, before assuming assigned operational duties. Maintain applicable pilot certificates, qualifications, currency, recurrent training, required checks, and medical eligibility where required by the company’s operating authorizations. Working closely with sales, marketing, and business development teams, you’ll transform platform-and-provider partnerships into active co-selling engines, joint campaigns, and scalable partner enablement programs that drive measurable business outcomes. This is a full-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr. What you'll do Develop and implement comprehensive annual partner marketing plans that align overall company growth targets with partner business objectives. Build and maintain strong relationships with key channel partners, collaborating regularly to execute joint go-to-market campaigns, co-marketing collateral, and events. Manage partner communication channels, including email campaigns and newsletters, while collaborating with program management on the partner portal. Adapt direct customer training and certification materials for partner technical teams, ensuring they are equipped to support end customers on Everlaw solutions. Track, analyze, and report on partner marketing budgets, campaign performance, and ROI to continuously optimize channel initiatives. jobs.title: Principal Partner Program Manager
jobs.description_text: The Role You will design, launch, and evolve Everlaw's partner programs to turn partner relationships into predictable, productive routes to market. As the primary externally facing leader for our partner ecosystem, you will shape the overall partner experience, establish clear tiers and engagement models, own the partner portal, and coordinate cross-functional enablement and governance as our ecosystem grows. This is a full-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr. What you'll do Design and evolve Everlaw’s partner program structure, including tiers, benefits, requirements, progression criteria, and engagement models. Own the partner portal as the current, self-service destination for partner onboarding, resources, communications, program guidance, and deal support. Program-manage core partner lifecycle processes across onboarding, activation, enablement, certification, and recurring communications. Coordinate cross-functional partner initiatives, campaigns, executive business reviews, and enablement moments across Business Development, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Legal, and Operations. Track program health and partner adoption, using data on tier progression, portal usage, and enablement participation to drive continuous program improvements. Document program governance and operating rules to ensure a consistent partner experience across all channels. About You You

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator (fixed-term)
jobs.description_text: The Role You’ll own the interview coordination process and candidate experience from the first phone call through the final onsite, ensuring every applicant moves through our talent pipeline smoothly and professionally. In a fast-moving hiring environment, you’ll rely on your organizational skills, knowledge of team priorities, and relationships across the business to manage complex schedules and unscripted demands with a calm, collected demeanor. This is a full-time, non-exempt, fixed-term position (expected length of 6 months) based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr. Note: the expected start time for this role is between 7-8 AM PT to help support our EST-based offices and interviewing needs. What you'll do... Schedule panel and onsite interviews across our offices based on well-defined interview plans. Become a power user in our scheduling tool (ModernLoop) and applicant tracking system (Greenhouse) to accurately turn around scheduling requests in a timely manner. Partner directly with our recruiters and hiring managers across the business to ensure candidates move through our recruiting process in a delightful and efficient manner. Use documented interview plans to schedule candidates for their next touchpoints in our hiring process.
